Subject: Private VPC / On-prem architecture review — next steps

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning to walk through FinServe's requirements. Quick recap from our call:

- Goal: Private VPC or on-prem deployment for inference with customer-managed KMS and audit logs.
- Key constraints: strict egress rules, dedicated subnet for GPU nodes, SOC2 audit evidence, and predictable latency for <150ms p50 requests.
- Stakeholders: Alex (SRE lead), Priya (Security/Compliance), plus your infra/networking team to validate connectivity.

Next step: we recommend a focused architecture review / technical deep dive with our Solutions Engineer and Platform Architect to go over network design, proposed deployment topology, and any firewall/NAT requirements. Monica (cc'd) will lead the technical discussion; Rishi will join for deployment patterns and any contract/ops items.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed 22 Jul — 10:00–11:00am PT
- Thu 23 Jul — 2:00–3:00pm PT
- Fri 24 Jul — 9:00–10:00am PT

If none of those work, please share a calendar link or a couple of preferred windows and we'll align. I'll attach a short pre-read and agenda to help your networking folks prepare.

Attachments: redwood-private-vpc-proposal.pdf (PDF, high-level topology & checklist)

Agenda (draft):
1) 10 min — goals & constraints recap (FinServe)
2) 25 min — proposed Private deployment topology + network flows (Redwood)
3) 15 min — connectivity checklist & firewall/NAT requirements
4) 10 min — next steps / timeline / owners

Thanks — looking forward to getting the right folks on the call.

Best,
